mapper.sql: et.taskId, et.empId, e.empName, et.tplId, tt.taskName, tt.dutyDept, e.entryTime, CAST(TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, tt.offsetDay, e.entryTime) AS DATE) AS dueDate, et.taskStatus, CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 AND CAST(TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, tt.offsetDay, e.entryTime) AS DATE) < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, e.isArchived AS archived, CASE WHEN e.isArchived = 0 AND et.taskStatus = 0 AND DATE(e.entryTime) <= CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS canFinish, et.finishTime
FROM emp_task et INNER JOIN employee e ON e.empId = et.empId INNER JOIN task_template tt ON tt.tplId = et.tplId

where.if: AND et.taskStatus = 0 AND CAST(TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, tt.offsetDay, e.entryTime) AS DATE) < CURRENT_DATE

mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO emp_task(empId, tplId, taskStatus, finishTime) VALUES
(#{item.empId}, #{item.tplId}, #{item.taskStatus}, #{item.finishTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp_task WHERE empId = #{empId} AND taskStatus = 0

SELECT e.empId, e.empName, COUNT(et.taskId) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 AND CAST(TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, tt.offsetDay, e.entryTime) AS DATE) < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount FROM employee e LEFT JOIN emp_task et ON et.empId = e.empId LEFT JOIN task_template tt ON tt.tplId = et.tplId WHERE e.empId = #{empId} GROUP BY e.empId, e.empName

SELECT tt.dutyDept, COUNT(et.taskId) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 AND CAST(TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, tt.offsetDay, e.entryTime) AS DATE) < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount FROM emp_task et INNER JOIN employee e ON e.empId = et.empId INNER JOIN task_template tt ON tt.tplId = et.tplId GROUP BY tt.dutyDept ORDER BY tt.dutyDept ASC

SELECT
WHERE et.taskStatus = 0 AND CAST(TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, tt.offsetDay, e.entryTime) AS DATE) < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY dueDate ASC, et.taskId ASC
